masters.name: interface-master-01-dialogs
masters.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a production-oriented, pixel-aligned, high-fidelity interface design sheet for the existing Chinese Cthulhu card game 邪神的宝藏. Input 1 is the actual main menu: the sole authority for art style. Input 2 is current gameplay: authority for game content and functional density. Redesign the actual FUNCTIONAL USER INTERFACES described below in the exact main-menu visual world. This is a UI master design, NOT a moodboard, NOT illustration studies. Flat-on orthographic digital UI, no device mockups, no perspective, no additional fictional game systems. Fine tarnished bronze double outlines and restrained engraved corners, smoky charcoal/teal stone panels, generous blank interior behind live text, parchment serif Chinese type with excellent readability, existing teal treasure/red hunter/purple cult role accents. Color #060707 background, #cbb293 text, #c8a96e bronze, #8fd0ca teal, #d26458 red, #a781cf purple. Buttons rectangular, 4px rounded corner, aged bronze edge, dark teal primary, charcoal secondary, muted blood-red danger. No rounded dashboard pills, neon or excessive filigree. Display actual clear Chinese headings and short labels; don't clutter with illegible miniature paragraphs. Keep text on its own visual plane. Borders and button surfaces should be suitable as slicing references. Output one 2400x1600 sheet in 3 columns by 2 rows, six equal 800x800-ish viewport studies with clearly separated modest gutters. Each viewport shows a complete functional panel with actual controls at sensible scale. Top left 联机对战: 创建房间 primary, 游戏大厅 secondary, 房间号 input and 加入房间, 用户名 row with 修改. Top middle 游戏大厅: 刷新 top right, two room list rows each with room code, 3/5 and 2/5 occupancy and 加入 button, empty space and bottom 返回. Top right 等待旅者: prominent room code A7K2M9 with 复制, five player rows with host badge, 已准备 / 未准备, bottom 离开房间 and 准备. Bottom left 选择本局身份: four selectable tiles 2x2 for 寻宝者 teal star, 追猎者 red cross, 邪祀者 purple crescent, 随机身份 bronze; identity purpose one line; subtle selected outline. Bottom middle 区域探寻: actual old-stone portrait card A2 遭遇塌方, short text 失去3HP并翻面, two clearly separated actions 收入手牌 / 弃置此牌; side-by-side card and explanation on wide panel. Bottom right 邪神降临: portrait dark Cthulhu card, description 信仰或抵抗, visible two actions 信仰 / 抵抗 and HP / SAN outcome row. Each study has the SAME calm solid material and same edge design; faint game background outside panel. No concept objects outside interface. Chinese content exactly as listed.

assets.name: panel-master
assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Output a SINGLE 1024x1024 square production UI panel texture, a clean directly sliceable asset. Reference image is the selected actual UI master for 邪神的宝藏. Extract and reproduce its quiet smoky charcoal/very dark teal stone panel and delicate weathered bronze double edge. Straight-on perfectly square orthographic geometry, completely opaque. Outer frame line exactly 8 pixels inside image boundary on all four sides; inner line 18 pixels inside. Small restrained symmetrical engraved corner details entirely within each 72x72 corner square. All remaining straight edges uniform so a 96px nine-slice works. The entire central 832x832 area MUST be an almost flat, VERY LOW CONTRAST black-green stone texture, no patterns, no figure, no vignette spot, no glyph, no scratches bright enough to compete with text. Border old rubbed copper #8e784e with fine highlights #c8a96e. Center #080f10. No UI content, no letters, no symbols, no numerals, no buttons, no logo, no watermark, no transparent padding. Fill canvas exactly. This is the source artwork for nine-slice dialogs and panels used by all real functional screens.

assets.name: interface-master-02-battle-corrected
assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE landscape 1920x1080 implementation-ready game screen for 邪神的宝藏. Image1 main menu defines material style, image2 current real battle defines actual layout. Fine weathered bronze frame, near-black teal stone panels, calm contrast, readable parchment Chinese serif. Preserve the exact identity and layout of a five player game: other four player panels across top with HP red SAN purple values, lower left own player panel, three card piles center, log right, full width hand and actions below. CRITICAL HARD REQUIREMENT: ALL GAME CARD FACES AND BACKS HAVE EXACT WIDTH TO HEIGHT RATIO 392:590 (0.6644068), portrait orientation. At no time create wide landscape cards. Four player back cards each should be about 52x78; own four cards exactly 112x169 or equal proportional scaling. Main hand area is at least 230 pixels high so full upright cards fit with space above and below. Entire cards visible, no cropping, squashing, perspective, tilt or shortening. Keep exact card framing from reference; text may use real example titles but must not invent mechanics. Top four names 艾伦 贝拉 卡洛斯 黛安娜. Labels HP SAN 检定 牌堆 弃牌堆 冒险日志 你的回合 手牌. Actions 掉包 休息 结束回合, small 暂停游戏 返回主界面. Background uses current forest stone ruin rather than inventing a new setting. Deep black-green surfaces, thin bronze edges, muted role colors. This is the corrected authoritative visual layout; no decorative concept collage, no device, no extra systems.
